tts.preview_text_default: This is a voice test, how does it sound?

preview_text.de: Dies ist ein Sprachtest. Wie hört es sich an?
preview_text.es: Esta es una prueba de vista previa de voz. ¿Cómo suena?

preview_text.pt: Este é um teste de visualização de voz. Como soa?
preview_text.it: Questo è un test di anteprima vocale. Come sounds?
preview_text.hi: यह एक वॉयस प्रीव्यू टेस्ट है। यह कैसा लग रहा है?
preview_text.th: นี่คือการทดสอบตัวอย่างเสียง เสียงเป็นอย่างไรบ้าง?
preview_text.vi: Đây là bản thử nghiệm giọng nói. Nghe như thế nào?
preview_text.id: Ini adalah tes pratinjau suara. Bagaimana kedengarannya?

modes.balanced: Default mode. Mild overflow prefers sentence splitting, light compression, and slight speed-up only when needed.
modes.strict: Stay closer to the original subtitle timing window. Compression is more aggressive and timing risks are surfaced earlier.
modes.preserve: Preserve meaning first. The system avoids strong compression and only applies limited speed-up to reduce severe overflow.
modes.off: When disabled, the system will not rewrite or adapt translated text specifically for dubbing.

controls.lockedByPreserve: Locked off in Preserve meaning mode (avoids rewrite/speed-up that changes intent). Switch to Balanced or Strict to enable.

off.title: Dubbing adaptation is off
off.description: When enabled, the system can compress long translations, borrow nearby gaps, and combine that with slight speech-rate adjustments.
off.segment: Once enabled, this area will show whether the current line is split into multiple speech segments and how much pause is reserved inside it.
off.source: Translated text is not being rewritten specifically for dubbing right now.
off.adapted: Switch to Balanced or Strict mode to see the adaptation result for the current subtitle here.

empty.title: No subtitle selected
empty.description: Select a subtitle to see its dubbing adaptation details here.
empty.segment: After you select a subtitle, this area will show how its dubbing is segmented.

stats.no_source: No translated text is available to show.
stats.no_dub_text: No dubbing-ready text has been generated yet.

segment.original_single: Currently dubbing the original text as a single segment.
segment.single: Currently using a single dubbed segment with no extra speech splitting.
segment.single_with_pause: Currently using a single dubbed segment with {pauseDuration}s of pause reserved inside the line.
segment.multi: Currently split into {segmentCount} speech segments with {pauseDuration}s of pause reserved inside the line.

preview_preserve.label: Will preserve meaning first
preview_preserve.description: This line is clearly over budget, so the system will prioritize preserving the full meaning and only apply limited speed-up.

preview_compress.label: Compression likely needed
preview_compress.description: Based on the current timing budget, this line is a better candidate for compression before dubbing.

preview_overflow.label: Timing may still be tight
preview_overflow.description: With the current settings, this dub may still run too long.

preview_original.label: Using original text for dubbing
preview_original.description: Timing adaptation is only estimated when the dubbing source is switched to the translation.

compressed.label: Compression applied
compressed.description: The translated line was shortened to fit the current timing window more closely.

preserve_meaning.label: Preserve meaning first
preserve_meaning.description: This line is clearly overlong, so the system avoids aggressive compression and instead preserves meaning with limited speed-up.

manual_needed.label: Manual review suggested
manual_needed.description: This line is still long enough that the automatic result may sound unnatural.

estimated_overflow.label: High timing risk
estimated_overflow.description: The system estimates that this dub may still exceed the available timing window.

fit.label: Timing fits
fit.description: This line does not need extra compression.
